mock_data.title: A Disappointment
mock_data.passage:
12 April 2002

Mr Ernest Blake
Chief Executive
Furniture By Design
10 Greenwood
London WC2H 8TJ

Dear Mr Blake,

I am writing to complain in the strongest possible terms about the non-arrival of the two sofa beds which I ordered from your firm. Your extensive advertising material stated quite clearly that all orders received by the middle of November would be processed before Christmas. I had several guests over the Christmas period and the non-arrival of the sofa beds left me high and dry with nowhere for the guests to sleep.

I am writing to you personally because I have failed to make any progress with this complaint with any of the employees of your company. Immediately after Christmas I began to go through the proper channels by contacting your so-called customer helpline, only to find that the line seemed to be permanently engaged. Presumably this was the result of many other customers being in the same boat as I was.

I thought that it was a step in the right direction when I finally did get through, but I could not have been more wrong. The young woman who answered the phone listened to my complaint politely and then said that the person who could deal with my complaint was away from his desk temporarily but that she would get him to phone me as soon as he returned.

Having waited several hours for this phone call, which never came, I once again called the helpline, but it was the same story as before. The line was engaged for hours and, when I did eventually get through, I was told that the person who could deal with my complaint was not available. This time I asked for this person's name and phoned him back only to discover it was his day off. I spent several days going from pillar to post without getting an explanation or an apology for the non-arrival of the sofa beds.

You are the chief executive of the company and the buck stops there. I have left no stone unturned in my attempts to find out what has happened to the furniture and when it will arrive. I am now seeking an explanation from you. If your pre-Christmas advertisements were, in fact, just pie in the sky, then please have the honesty to say so and refund my money.

Yours sincerely,
Marjorie Wood
Marjorie Wood (Mrs)

mock_data.passageC1:
Dear Mr. Blake,

I am writing to register my profound dissatisfaction, indeed, my utter dismay, regarding the egregious delay in the delivery of the two sofa beds I ordered from Furniture By Design. Your promotional materials, ostensibly designed to inspire confidence, explicitly stated that orders placed before mid-November would be fulfilled before Christmas. As it transpired, the non-arrival of these items left me in a decidedly precarious position, having to accommodate several overnight guests with absolutely no provision for their comfort.

My decision to address you directly stems from the frustratingly unproductive exchanges I have endured with your company's customer service representatives. Immediately following the festive period, I endeavoured to pursue the matter through the prescribed channels, only to discover that your customer helpline appeared to be perpetually unavailable. One can only surmise that a multitude of similarly aggrieved customers were experiencing identical difficulties.

My initial optimism upon finally connecting with a representative proved to be entirely misplaced. The young woman who answered my call, while ostensibly polite, merely informed me that the individual responsible for handling my complaint was temporarily absent from his desk, assuring me that he would return my call expeditiously. Several hours elapsed without any communication whatsoever. Upon contacting the helpline again, I encountered the same familiar obstacle: a persistently engaged line. When I eventually succeeded in getting through, I was met with the identical refrain – the relevant individual was unavailable. On this occasion, I insisted on obtaining his name and subsequently attempted to contact him directly, only to discover it was his designated day of absence. I spent several days being passed from pillar to post, without receiving a coherent explanation, let alone an apology, for the conspicuous absence of my sofa beds.

As Chief Executive, ultimate responsibility rests with you. I have exhausted all avenues in my attempts to ascertain the status of my order and its anticipated delivery date. I now seek a definitive explanation from you personally. If your pre-Christmas promises were, in reality, nothing more than empty rhetoric, I demand that you acknowledge this with candour and issue a full refund without further delay. I trust you will treat this matter with the urgency it warrants, and I look forward to a prompt resolution.

Yours sincerely,

Marjorie Wood (Mrs)

12 aprel 2002

Janob Ernest Bleyk
Bosh direktor
Furniture By Design
10 Grinvud
London WC2H 8TJ

Hurmatli janob Bleyk,

Men sizning firmangizdаn buyurtma qilgan ikki divan-karavotning yetib kelmasligi haqida eng kuchli so'zlar bilan shikoyat qilish uchun yozyapman. Sizning keng ko'lamli reklama materiallaringizda noyabr o'rtasigacha qabul qilingan barcha buyurtmalar Rojdestvogacha qayta ishlanishi aniq aytilgan edi. Rojdestvo davrida menda bir nechta mehmonlar bo'ldi va divan-karavotlarning yetib kelmasligi mehmonlarni uxlatadigan joyi yo'q holda meni dahshatli ahvolda qoldirdi.

Men sizga shaxsan yozyapman, chunki men bu shikoyat bilan kompaniyangizning hech bir xodimi bilan hech qanday oldinga siljiy olmadim. Rojdestvo bayramidan keyin darhol to'g'ri yo'ldan borgandman, sizning mijozlar yordam xattingizga qo'ng'iroq qildim, faqat liniya doimiy ravishda band ekanligini aniqladim. Ehtimol, bu ko'plab boshqa mijozlarning ham men bilan bir xil ahvolda bo'lganligi natijasi edi.

Nihoyat bog'langanimda bu to'g'ri yo'nalishda qadam deb o'yladim, ammo ko'proq xato qila olmadim. Telefonni javob bergan yosh ayol mening shikoyatimni nazokat bilan tingladi va keyin mening shikoyatim bilan shug'ullanishi mumkin bo'lgan odam vaqtinchalik stolidan uzoqda ekanligini, ammo u qaytgan zahoti menga qo'ng'iroq qilishini aytdi.

Bu qo'ng'iroqni bir necha soat kutganimdan keyin, u hech qachon kelmadi, men yana yordam liniyasiga qo'ng'iroq qildim, ammo bu avvalgidek bir xil hikoya edi. Liniya soatlab band edi va oxir-oqibat bog'langanimda, mening shikoyatim bilan shug'ullanishi mumkin bo'lgan odam mavjud emasligini aytishdi. Bu safar men bu odamning ismini so'radim va unga qo'ng'iroq qildim, faqat uning dam olish kuni ekanligini bildim. Men bir necha kun davomida u yerdan bu yerga yugurdim, divan-karavotlarning yetib kelmasligi uchun tushuntirish yoki uzr olmadim.

Siz kompaniyaning bosh direktorisiz va javobgarlik sizda. Men mebelga nima bo'lgani va qachon yetib kelishini aniqlash uchun hamma yo'lni sinab ko'rdim. Hozir sizdan tushuntirish so'rayapman. Agar sizning Rojdestvogacha reklamalaringiz aslida faqat xayoliy orzular bo'lsa, iltimos, halollik bilan aytib, pulimni qaytarib bering.

Hurmat bilan,
Marjori Vud

2002 yil, 12 aprel

Ernest Bleyk janob
Bosh direktor
"Furniture By Design"
10 Grinvud ko'chasi

Hurmatli Bleyk janob,

Sizga murojaat qilishimning sababi, sizning kompaniyangizdan buyurtma bergan divan-karovatlar haqida juda xafaman. Sizning reklamalaringizda, agar biz noyabr oyining o'rtasidan oldin buyurtma bersak, buyurtmalarimizni Rojdestvodan oldin olishimiz aytilgan edi. Rojdestvo paytida mening mehmonlarim bor edi va divan-karovatlar kelmagani sababli, ularning uxlashga joyi yo'q edi.

Sizga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri murojaat qilishimning sababi, kompaniyangiz xodimlaridan yordam olishda muammolarga duch keldim. Rojdestvodan so'ng, men sizning mijozlar yordam liniyangizga murojaat qilishga harakat qildim. Ammo telefon liniyasi doimo band edi. O'ylashimcha, ko'plab boshqa mijozlarda ham men bilan bir xil muammo bor edi.

Nihoyat kim bilandir bog'lana olganimda, vaziyat yaxshilanadi deb o'ylagandim. Ammo men adashdim. Bir ayol telefonga javob berdi va mening shikoyatimni tingladi. Uning aytishicha, menga yordam bera oladigan odam o'z stolida yo'q, lekin u tez orada menga qo'ng'iroq qiladi.

Men uning qo'ng'irog'ini kutdim, lekin u hech qachon kelmadi. Shunday qilib, men yana yordam liniyasiga qo'ng'iroq qildim. Xuddi shu narsa sodir bo'ldi - liniya soatlab band edi. Nihoyat bog'lana olganimda, menga xuddi shu odam mavjud emasligi aytildi. Bu safar men uning ismini so'radim va unga qayta qo'ng'iroq qildim. Ammo u o'sha kuni ishlamayotgan edi. Men ma'lumot olishga kunlar sarfladim, ammo yo'qolgan divan-karovatlar uchun hech qanday tushuntirish yoki kechirim ololmadim.

Siz kompaniyaning bosh direktori bo'lganingiz uchun mas'ulsiz. Men mebelga nima bo'lganini va qachon kelishini bilish uchun hamma narsani qildim. Men hozir sizdan tushuntirish olmoqchiman. Agar sizning reklamalaringiz rost bo'lmasa, iltimos, menga ayting va pulimni qaytarib bering.

Hurmat bilan,

Marjorie Vud (xonim)

Dastlab men kimdir bilan bog'lana olganimda muvaffaqiyatga erishyotgandek tuyuldi. Biroq, men adashdim. Mening qo'ng'irog'imga javob bergan vakil shikoyatimni tingladi va tegishli shaxs vaqtincha yo'qligini, lekin imkon qadar tezroq menga qo'ng'iroq qilishini aytdi.

Hech qachon bo'lmagan qo'ng'iroqni bir necha soat kutganimdan so'ng, men yana yordam liniyasiga qo'ng'iroq qildim, lekin xuddi shu muammoga duch keldim. Liniya soatlab band edi va oxir-oqibat bog'lana olganimda, menga shikoyatimni hal qila oladigan shaxs hali ham yo'qligini aytishdi. Bu safar men shaxsning ismini so'radim va ularga qayta qo'ng'iroq qildim, lekin ularning dam olish kuni ekanligini aniqladim. Men bir necha kun davomida divan-krovatlarning yetkazib berilmaganligi uchun hech qanday tushuntirish yoki uzr so'ramasdan, bir odamdan ikkinchisiga o'tib yurdim.

Kompaniyaning bosh direktori sifatida siz oxir-oqibat mas'ulsiz. Mebelimga nima bo'lganini va qachon kelishini bilishga urinishda men barcha yo'llarni tugatdim. Men hozir sizdan izoh so'rayapman. Agar sizning Rojdestvodan oldingi reklamalaringiz shunchaki soxta va'dalar bo'lsa, buni tan olganingiz va to'liq pulni qaytarib berganingiz uchun minnatdor bo'lardim.

Hurmat bilan,

Marjorie Vud (xonim)
